LanguageData.STB_FeedFromHoppersDesc: If on, this machine takes fuel from a hopper on its intake (the green-marked port) whenever it drops below its target fuel level. Works with the fuel hopper, the vanilla hopper, and Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Factory hoppers. Turn off to keep a hopper's contents for something else.
LanguageData.STB_ModeDescDBH:
What the Stirling engine's cold side does. Click to cycle.

Power: makes its own power.
Water-cooled: draws water from the plumbing to run its cold side cooler, for {0} output while water is flowing.
Heat recovery: sends its heat into the plumbing as a boiler, for hot water and central heating, at {1} output.
LanguageData.STB_ValveDesc: Open or close this pressurised hot water line.
LanguageData.STB_SettingAdvanced: Advanced play mode (burners and steam turbines)
LanguageData.STB_SettingAdvancedDesc: On: gasifiers are burners that feed steam turbines through pressurised hot water pipes. Off: gasifiers are simple self-contained generators.
LanguageData.STB_SettingAdvancedExplain: Advanced: each gasifier is a burner with three modes - eco (most heat from each brick), normal and high (most heat). Pipe burners to steam turbines, radiators and Overpressure Tanks; heat nothing uses builds pressure, and a cobbled gasifier with nowhere to put it bursts. With no turbine on its network, a burner's own Stirling engine makes a little power from three times that in heat. With Dubs Bad Hygiene, heat the network leaves over goes to the plumbing's hot water and heating.
LanguageData.STB_SettingSimpleExplain: Simple: each gasifier is a self-contained generator - 1000W for the cobbled one, 1200W for the trash gasifier - with no pipes or turbines. With Dubs Bad Hygiene, they can also be water-cooled or used as boilers.
LanguageData.STB_SettingRestart: Modes and power switch over straight away. Restart the game to add or remove the turbines and pipes in the build menu.
LanguageData.STB_BurnRateDesc: How hard this burner runs. Click to cycle. Eco gets the most heat from each brick but makes the least; high makes the most heat, wastes the most fuel and heats the room most. The Stirling engine runs only with no steam turbine on the network, and takes three times its output in heat.\n{0}
LanguageData.STB_BurnRateLine: {0}: {1}W on {2} fuel a day ({3}W per brick a day); Stirling {4}W, leaving {5}W of heat
LanguageData.STB_BurnerStatus: Burning at {0}W of heat, {1} fuel a day
LanguageData.STB_SettingHazardsDesc: Off: burners without a safety valve vent instead of bursting, and pipes never leak.
LanguageData.STB_SettingOtherFuels: Burners also take wood, chemfuel, deepchem, hay, cloth and bioferrite
LanguageData.STB_SettingOtherFuelsDesc: A wood log is worth 0.4 of a trashbrick, a unit of chemfuel 2.5, hay 0.15, cloth 0.25, bioferrite 4 and deepchem 3. Each burner picks which it takes on its fuel bill. Loose trash, wastepacks and corpses are always on it. Takes effect after a restart.
LanguageData.STB_BurstText: The {0} built up more pressure than its jerry-rigged plumbing could hold and burst, filling everything within five tiles with scalding steam. Anyone caught in it is burned, and the room is dangerously hot until it cools.\n\nIt needs repairing before it will burn again. A burner builds pressure when the heat it makes has nowhere to go: turbines full or switched off, radiators satisfied, Overpressure Tanks full. Turn it down to eco, add a turbine or an Overpressure Tank - or build a trash gasifier, which has a safety valve.
LanguageData.STB_LeakMessage: A {0} has sprung a steam leak. It will scald anyone nearby until it's repaired.
LanguageData.STB_AlertOverpressureDesc: These burners have no safety valve and are building pressure because their heat has nowhere to go. At full pressure they burst into a 1000°C steam cloud.\n\nTurn them down, switch them off, or give the heat somewhere to go: another turbine, a radiator, an Overpressure Tank.
LanguageData.STB_AlertTurbineIdleDesc: These turbines are switched on but no burner on their network is sending them heat. Check the pipes and valves, and that the burners are lit and fuelled.
LanguageData.STB_AlertOutOfFuelDesc: These trashbrick burners have run dry. Refuel them, or put a hopper on their intake.
LanguageData.STB_BoilerOffering: Hot water: offering {0} heating units to the plumbing
LanguageData.STB_BoilerIdle: Hot water: nothing to offer the plumbing
LanguageData.STB_BoilerNetwork: DBH sees on this plumbing: {0} U of tanks and radiators, {1} U from all boilers
LanguageData.STB_BoilerNoPlumbing: Not on DBH plumbing: lay a plumbing pipe under it.
LanguageData.STB_BoilerNoStores: No working hot water tanks or radiators on this plumbing (a closed radiator valve counts as none).
LanguageData.STB_HotWaterShareDesc: The share of this burner's heat offered to Dubs Bad Hygiene's hot water tanks and radiators FIRST, before the steam turbines. Left-click to step it up, right-click to pick.\n\nWhatever the plumbing doesn't actually draw of it goes on to the turbines, so a high share only costs power when the tanks and radiators really want the heat. At 0% the plumbing only gets what the network leaves over.
LanguageData.STB_HotWaterShareStatus: Hot water share: {0} ({1}W offered first), drawn: {2}W
LanguageData.STB_AccIdleNoPipe: Not connected to a pressurised hot water pipe.
LanguageData.STB_AccIdleTurbinesTakeAll: Idle: the turbines and radiators are using all the heat.
LanguageData.STB_SyncBurnersDesc: Copy this burner's mode (eco, normal or high), hot water share and fuel choices to other burners.\n\nLeft-click: every burner on this burner's hot water network (or the whole map, if it isn't piped to anything). Right-click to choose.
LanguageData.STB_SyncNetwork: Burners on this hot water network
LanguageData.STB_AccRisk: Explosion risk: {0} a day (blast out to {1} tiles)
LanguageData.STB_AccWear: Last bled {0} days ago: risk x{1}
LanguageData.STB_AccCobbled: Cobbled burner on the network: risk x{0}
LanguageData.STB_AccBleedPending: Waiting for a colonist to bleed it down to {0}.
LanguageData.STB_AccBleedDesc:
Have a colonist (basic work) open the blow-off valve. The stored heat drops to the chosen level and goes into the room the tank is in, and the valve wear resets.

A tank's explosion risk rises with how full it is, with the days since it was last bled, and four times over while a cobbled gasifier - which has no safety valve - is piped to its network.

Left-click: request or cancel. Right-click: choose how far down.
LanguageData.STB_AccExplodedText: An Overpressure Tank at {0} let go, throwing a blast and a cloud of scalding steam out to {1} tiles.\n\nFull tanks, cobbled gasifiers and worn valves make this likelier. Bleed tanks now and then, or set them to auto-release.
LanguageData.STB_AlertAccRiskDesc: An Overpressure Tank is full enough, worn enough or near a cobbled gasifier to have a real chance of exploding.\n\nSelect it and use Bleed to have a colonist let pressure off, or turn on auto-release.
LanguageData.STB_BurnRateLineNoEngine: {0}: {1}W on {2} fuel a day ({3}W per brick a day)
LanguageData.STB_NoNetworkNoEngine: Nothing piped to it: no engine on board, pipe it to a steam turbine.
LanguageData.STB_RadiatorValveDesc: Open or close the valve feeding this radiator. Closed, it takes no heat from the hot water network - for rooms you don't want heated. No electricity is involved.
LanguageData.STB_StirlingStatus: Stirling engine: {0}W of power from {1}W of heat (no turbine on its network)
LanguageData.STB_StirlingOffTurbine: Stirling engine off: a steam turbine is on its network
LanguageData.STB_UnusedHeat: Heat with nowhere to go: {0}W - pipe it to an Overpressure Tank or radiators
LanguageData.STB_TurbineStalled: STALLED: {0}W is under the {1}W this gear needs, and the heat is wasted.
LanguageData.STB_TurbineFromTank: Kept turning by the Overpressure Tank.
LanguageData.STB_TurbineGearDesc: Higher gears turn more of the heat into power, but need more heat to turn at all. Below its gear's minimum the turbine stalls: it still takes the heat, and wastes it. An Overpressure Tank on the network tops a stalling turbine up while it has heat to give. Left-click to step, right-click to pick.\n{0}
LanguageData.STB_AlertTurbineStalledDesc: These turbines are taking heat but getting less than their gear needs to turn, so the heat is wasted and they make no power. Shift them to a lower gear, or send them more heat.
LanguageData.STB_AutoReleaseDesc: Vent steam on its own above a level you set, so it stays safe without a colonist bleeding it. The vented heat goes into the room it's in - a lot of it. Build it outdoors, or somewhere that can take the heat.
LanguageData.STB_ReleaseLevelDesc: The fill level above which it vents on its own. Lower is safer and heats the room more. Left-click steps 25/50/75/100%; right-click to pick.
LanguageData.STB_TankToPlumbing: To DBH hot water and heating: {0}W (tanks and radiators short {1} U)
LanguageData.STB_SettingRequireWater: Burners need plumbing water (Dubs Bad Hygiene)
LanguageData.STB_SettingRequireWaterDesc: On: in advanced play mode, a burner only burns while Dubs Bad Hygiene plumbing supplies its water - 20 to 53 a day by mode. Off: burners draw water when they can but run without it.
LanguageData.STB_NoWaterStopped: NO WATER: needs {0} water a day from DBH plumbing to burn. Lay a plumbing pipe under it, connected to a water supply.
LanguageData.STB_WaterUse: Water: {0} a day from the plumbing
LanguageData.STB_AlertNoWaterDesc: These burners are fuelled and switched on but aren't burning: with Dubs Bad Hygiene they need water from the plumbing.\n\nLay a plumbing pipe under them and connect it to a water supply (a well or pump, and a water tower). This can be switched off in the mod settings.
LanguageData.STB_VentDrainDesc: Whether this vent also drains the Overpressure Tanks on its network. It always blows off heat nothing else wants; set a level and it also bleeds the tanks down to it, keeping their explosion risk low - but the stored heat is lost to the steam. Left-click to step, right-click to pick.
LanguageData.STB_VentValveDesc: Open or close this steam vent. Closed, it vents nothing.
LanguageData.STB_ExhaustToPorts: Exhaust: piped to {0} exhaust ports, polluting {1} cells a day there
LanguageData.STB_ExhaustLocal: EXHAUST: no exhaust pipe to an open, powered exhaust port - venting toxic gas around it and polluting {0} cells a day here
LanguageData.STB_PortActive: Letting out exhaust: polluting about {0} cells a day around it
LanguageData.STB_PortIndoors: Indoors: filling this room with toxic gas. Move it outside.
LanguageData.STB_DamperDesc: Open or close this exhaust port. Closed - or without power - exhaust goes to the other ports on the network, or, with none open, back out of the burners as toxic gas.
LanguageData.STB_AlertToxicExhaustDesc: These burners have no exhaust pipe to an open, powered exhaust port, so their exhaust is backing up and coming out around them as toxic gas.\n\nRun an exhaust pipe from under them to an exhaust port built outdoors, and make sure the port's draught fan has power.
LanguageData.STB_PortNoPower: NO POWER: the draught fan has stopped. Exhaust is backing up into the burners.
LanguageData.STB_SourceToPorts: Exhaust: its toxic gas goes down the exhaust pipe to {0} exhaust ports
LanguageData.STB_SourceNoPort: Exhaust: no open, powered exhaust port on its exhaust pipe - the toxic gas comes out here
LanguageData.STB_FuelMix: Fuel mix: x{0} ground pollution, x{1} toxic gas (against trashbricks)
LanguageData.STB_FuelMixRot: Burning corpses: rot stink x{0} (against trashbricks' toxic gas)
LanguageData.STB_SettingFactoryFumes: Factory machines give off fumes (Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Factory)
LanguageData.STB_SettingFactoryFumesDesc: On: the dirty factory machines - smelter, alloy forge, biofuel refinery, neutroamine synthesizer, ammunition press, medicine granulator and conveyor crematorium - give off toxic gas while they work, and a little ground pollution; the crematorium adds rot stink. Run exhaust pipe under them to a powered exhaust port to send the fumes outside. The pollution slider scales them.
LanguageData.STB_FumesRot: {0} toxic gas and {1} rot stink a day
LanguageData.STB_FuelBillDesc: Open this burner's fuel bill: which fuels colonists and hoppers may feed it, and how far colonists will go to fetch them - like a bill's ingredient filter and search radius. Fuel already in the burner still burns.
LanguageData.STB_FuelValuesHeader: What each fuel is worth in trashbricks, and how dirty it burns against a trashbrick (toxic gas, ground pollution). Hay, cloth, bioferrite, deepchem and corpses start refused.
LanguageData.STB_FuelLineCorpse: Corpses: worth 1 brick per {0} kg of body (a human about {1}); stripped as they go in. Gas x{2}, rot stink x{3}, pollution x{4}
LanguageData.STB_SettingSteamCloudsDesc: On: steam from vents, Overpressure Tank releases and bleeds, safety valves, leaks and bursts hangs in the air as a white cloud. It spreads through open cells and open doors, drifts off quickly outdoors, and indoors fills the room and keeps it hot - up to about 100°C - until it condenses. Off: steam is just puffs, and only the heat stays.
